plainTranslation: With Composite Mercury in the 10th house, you can communicate with one another about practical matters and try to say what needs to be said, but not too much more than that. You can avoid getting into fights if they don't seem to serve any kind of purpose, and you can keep emotions out of it, but need to work on being more open, if it's a personal relationship. This can be excellent for a business relationship since this is the house of career, and together you can map out a course of action for your common goals that can lead to success.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
